headline: Morgan Stanley Maintains Equal-Weight on EPAM Systems, Lowers Price Target to $100
summary: Morgan Stanley  analyst James Faucette   maintains EPAM Systems (NYSE:EPAM) with a Equal-Weight and lowers the price target from $112 to $100.
